title: No little kids allowed, and other new info about Tesla’s Cybercab
summary: The company says no children under 13 can ride -- even with a parent. That's more restrictive than the Model Y SUVs it's using as robotaxis.
llm_summary: Tesla’s upcoming Cybercab— the robotaxi version of the Cybertruck— will prohibit any passengers under 13, even if they’re accompanied by an adult. This age restriction is stricter than the policy currently applied to the Model Y SUVs already being
